findings.title: Monthly Revenue Trend
findings.evidence: Peak revenue in July 2025 with $1,299,501.11. Lowest in February 2025 with $620,391.49.
findings.limitations: Missing months with no transactions are omitted; data only covers 2024-2025.

findings.title: Top Products by Revenue
findings.evidence: Top 5 products: P01, P00, P15, P09, P18 generating 7,431,974.06 of total revenue.
findings.limitations: Product list limited to those with transactions; seasonal effects not isolated.

findings.title: Revenue Share by Region
findings.evidence: Region R0 accounts for 27.6% of revenue.
findings.limitations: Region definitions may overlap; data only includes transactions with region_id present.

findings.title: Revenue by Customer Segment
findings.limitations: Segment mapping may be incomplete; some customers missing segment info.

findings.title: Top 10 Customers
findings.limitations: Customer IDs may be duplicated; no demographic context.

findings.limitations: Outlier definition may flag legitimate large orders; further review needed.
